input: Let people export a report as CSV, and send it to them by email every Monday.
kindReason: It has two stories that each ship on their own: the export, and the weekly email.
title: Export reports as CSV
summary: A person can download any report as a CSV file, and can ask for it by email every Monday. Today reports can only be read on screen.

stories.title: Download a report as CSV
stories.why: Most people only need the file, and the email builds on it.

scenarios.then: a file with a header line and 3 rows is saved
a file with only the header line is saved

stories.title: Get the report by email every Monday
stories.why: People who check the numbers weekly stop opening the app for them.

scenarios.given: a person subscribed to a report
scenarios.when: Monday 08:00 in their time zone passes
scenarios.then: one email with the CSV attached is sent to them

requirements.text: System MUST write CSV with a header line and one line per row.
System MUST send the weekly email at most once per person per report.

success.text: A report of 10,000 rows downloads in under 5 seconds.
Every subscribed person gets exactly one email each Monday.

edgeCases: What happens when a cell holds a comma or a line break?
assumptions: People read the file in a spreadsheet program.

open.text: Who may subscribe other people to a report?

questions.text: Who may subscribe other people to a report?
questions.evidence: The input says send it to them, but not whether a person may add someone else.

options.label: Only themselves
options.consequence: Each person subscribes on their own.

options.label: Anyone who can see the report
options.consequence: People can add colleagues, who may not want the email.

recommendation.why: No one gets an email they did not ask for.

assumed.text: The CSV uses commas and UTF-8.
assumed.why: It is what spreadsheet programs open without asking.

split.title: Download a report as CSV
split.goal: A person can download any report as a CSV file.
acceptance: Given a report with 3 rows, when the person chooses Download CSV, then a file with a header line and 3 rows is saved

split.title: Get the report by email every Monday
split.goal: A subscribed person gets the CSV by email every Monday.
acceptance: Given a person subscribed to a report, when Monday 08:00 passes, then one email with the CSV attached is sent
